title: Good, but need more functions
body:
This app gives you a clean slate every day and balances well between giving advice and tips without becoming overwhelming.

It claims that it gives councelling as well, although it is obvious that you are talking to someone who relies heavily on AI generated answers. They should be honest about you talking to a chatbot.

It would also be helpful if there was a function that let’s you plan your day and week ahead.
author: Overwhelmed App-etizer
